project_type: C++20 tiered-streaming MoE inference engine (fork of llama.cpp, vendored submodule); StrataFlow by Coaade Inc.
language: C++20 (StrataFlow modules); vendored llama.cpp/ggml stays C++17/C
build_system: CMake 3.22 + Ninja with presets. Our targets C++20 only (never global CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD). STATIC libs (BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF). STRATAFLOW_WERROR for clang parity. GCC 11.5 / Clang 15.
test_framework: ctest via presets; one test_*.cpp per module under tests/, registered in tests/CMakeLists.txt. GGUF-dependent tests skip cleanly when the fixture/python is unavailable (STRATAFLOW_TEST_GGUF pattern).
verification_instructions: 1) git submodule update --init --recursive (llama.cpp @ b11379). 2) cmake --preset debug && cmake --build build/debug. 3) ctest --preset debug. 4) clang parity: CC=clang CXX=clang++ cmake -S . -B build/clang -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DSTRATAFLOW_WERROR=ON then build+test. Spike build pattern: g++ -std=c++17 -fopenmp -I third_party/llama.cpp/include -I .../ggml/include -I .../ggml/src <spike>.cpp -L build/debug/lib -lllama -lggml -lggml-cpu -lggml-base -lpthread -lm (the -fopenmp is REQUIRED or ggml-quants fails to link with GOMP_* undefined).
snapshot_or_generated_files: Test fixture is generated, not committed: uv run --with gguf --with numpy python3 tools/testdata/make_tiny_moe_gguf.py <out.gguf>. Emits a 2-layer, 8-expert, top-2, F32 llama-arch MoE. No checked-in snapshots.
setup_instructions: Submodule init as above. Fixture generation as above. Throwaway spikes live under spike/ (source committed, binaries gitignored); write throwaway data files under /projects/sandbox, never /tmp.
environment_constraints: This is a DESIGN+FEASIBILITY task: produce docs/TASK5_DESIGN.md on branch phase-3/task-5-design; do NOT implement the full task and do NOT push. llama.cpp libs already built in build/debug/lib. The fixture is F32, so at runtime it exercises the PLAIN mul_mat_id path (the tiled path engages only for specific K-quant types); the tiled path is confirmed by source reading.
contribution_requirements: New files carry: // Copyright 2026 Coaade Inc., a Delaware C corporation. SPDX-License-Identifier: LicenseRef-Coaade-Source-Available-1.0 . ABI additions to include/strataflow/strataflow.h MUST be append-only at struct end with defaults filled in sf_context_default_params(). Determinism (byte-identical greedy output across memory budgets) is a hard CONTRIBUTING rule. No edits inside ggml/ or llama/ source (rebase-friendliness).
key_patterns: strata_stream_buft is a custom ggml_backend_buffer_type (src/tws/stream_buft.*) that owns routed-expert FFN tensors. load_ggml_model (src/model/ggml_model.cpp) re-points the Phase 2 tensor_buft_overrides at it when streaming/forced (STRATAFLOW_FORCE_STREAM_EXPERTS=1), after a gguf_* no_alloc metadata pre-pass (read_shape_from_gguf). stream_buft_ensure_decode_residency(prefill) runs right before each llama_decode. SlotPool (src/tws/weight_store.*) is LRU, keyed by ExpertId{layer,expert}. BlockFile (src/tws/async_io.*) does 4KiB-aligned direct I/O, kIoAlignment=4096, align_up/down. parse_expert_tensor_name maps blk.N.ffn_{gate,down,up,gate_up}_exps -> {layer,kind}.
relevant_files: docs/PHASE3_PLAN.md (Task 5 spec, Tasks 2/3 context, section 8 spike result)
directory_structure: src/{tws,model,plan,predict,sched,hw,kv,common,api}, include/strataflow/, tools/{testdata,...}, tests/, spike/ (throwaway), docs/, third_party/llama.cpp (submodule @ b11379).
